model.title: A resolution expressing support for the designation of November 15, 2026, as "National Warrior Call Day" and recognizing the importance of connecting members of the Armed Forces and veterans in the United States to support structures necessary to transition from the battlefield, especially peer-to-peer connection.

whatsNext.text: Policy adoption (this kind of resolution doesn't become law)

honesty.lead: This path starts where the bill does — its first action in the official record.
